item.title: ICE shootings heighten criticism of Kristi Noem’s tenure at DHS
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem speaks during a news conference in Washington after federal immigration agents shot and killed another U.S. citizen on Saturday morning, later identified as Alex Pretti, during operations in Minneapolis.
